stages_1_to_3.code: compute every child-versus-exact-parent changed managed-Flash sector; include parent/candidate bytes and SHA-256
stages_1_to_3.official: also provide inherited-plus-new exact official-v15 rollback

stage_4.data: identify every touched erase sector, capture and hash whole sectors before first write, restore only to the same unit
stage_4.separation: code rollback and data restore are distinct artifacts

stop_if: sector inventory is predicted instead of computed
parent identity or rollback hashes do not match
Stage 4 data erase sectors or neighboring records are unresolved
